text: 证监会披露行政处罚决定书，陈欢、周厚禄、李萍萍在2023年2月20日至2024年8月1日期间，控制使用多个他人证券账户，通过集中资金优势、持股优势连续买卖，以及在实际控制账户之间交易等手段，影响相关股票价格和交易量，构成操纵证券市场行为。证监会决定对三人合计罚款800万元，其中陈欢、李萍萍分别罚款300万元，周厚禄罚款200万元，并分别对三人采取3年、3年、2年证券市场禁止交易措施。
text_en: The CSRC disclosed an administrative penalty decision. Chen Huan, Zhou Houlu, and Li Pingping, during the period from February 20, 2023 to August 1, 2024, controlled and used multiple securities accounts of others and, by concentrating capital advantages and shareholding advantages to conduct continuous trading, as well as trading between accounts under actual control, affected the prices and trading volumes of relevant stocks, constituting securities market manipulation. The CSRC decided to impose a total fine of 8 million yuan on the three individuals, among whom Chen Huan and Li Pingping were each fined 3 million yuan and Zhou Houlu was fined 2 million yuan, and imposed securities market trading bans on the three individuals for 3 years, 3 years, and 2 years respectively.
